issue.title: Decide whether to retire project-date propagation onto residents (ADJ-8)

task_type_fields.proposal: Decide, with Bryan, whether bob projects sync and nav should stop copying the ^prj inline date onto residents (raise-only copies, including the known limit that a hand edit moving the date earlier keeps old copies). If retired, #prj_is_blocked plus the project_schedule reason become the only signal. Needs a decision record and changes in sync, nav schedule and capture.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Out of scope for epic bob-cli-6u (plan:202610/prj_line_project_blocking.md lists it under Deliberately not doing / publish follow-ups); proposed by bob-cli-6u.17. The plan explicitly calls retiring ADJ-8 a separate decision.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-6u.17 (note #6): the plan kept ADJ-8 propagation as a separate decision; with #prj_is_blocked and project_schedule reasons it may be redundant.

payload.entry: Cascade coordination: schedule_cascade = yes applies to Task Card Schedule changes on a ^prj, while project dates remain residence-only and are not copied to descendant notes.
